name: tanowaf/waf-core
description: A php library for building Web Application Firewalls

suggest.ext-curl: Required (atm at least) for connecting to unix-socket based upstreams and many other nice http features
suggest.ext-brotli: Necessary to be able to inspect and modify received brotli-compressed message bodies
suggest.ext-mbstring: Recommended for juggling between charsets in case not every request and response is utf8
suggest.ext-zstd: Necessary to be able to inspect and modify received zstd-compressed message bodies
suggest.symfony/http-client: Either this or guzzlehttp/guzzle are required
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Either this or symfony/http-client are required

scripts.setup-git-hooks: if ln -s -f $(pwd)/.githooks/pre-push.sh .git/hooks/pre-push; then echo hooks installed; else echo fail; fi
